title: Camera Flash
blurb: Shutter click, then the thin electronic whine of a flash recharging — a sound modern cameras only make because we asked them to. Digital sensors have no mirror to slap and no bulb to burn, so every click and hum you hear is a deliberate skeuomorph, kept alive because photography feels wrong without it. Editors use the clip to freeze a frame: hit it on a still and the audience reads the moment as a photograph. Paparazzi gags, dramatic reveals and reaction memes all run on this exact two-second package.
origin: A camera shutter with the whine of a flash recharging.
